title: Provider-neutral harness seam and the dsh adapter
summary: Introduces a provider-neutral `harness` module — a `Harness` trait, a `CommandRunner` seam with a real process runner, plain-data results, capability reporting and a prompt/question contract — plus the first concrete adapter, `DshHarness`, which drives `dsh --profile headless --json -` through that runner, parses its newline-delimited JSON events, guards the repository with git status/head/branch probes, and reports what it can and cannot do. A `job-blocked` journal payload carries a clarification question, and in-memory fakes plus recorded fixtures make the whole run testable without starting a process.

nodes.label: osf crate root
nodes.subtitle: lib.rs
nodes.summary: Registers the two new modules, `harness` and `dsh_harness`, so the rest of the crate can reach the seam and the adapter.

nodes.label: Journal payloads
nodes.subtitle: Payload::JobBlocked
nodes.summary: Adds a `JobBlocked` payload carrying the job, the work item, a cause name and an optional question, and threads it through replay so a blocked job round-trips.

nodes.label: RUN_ENV_VARS
nodes.subtitle: reviewers.rs
nodes.summary: Widens the shared environment allow-list from private to crate-visible so the adapter can reuse it when building the minimal git environment.

nodes.label: Harness trait
nodes.subtitle: run + capabilities
nodes.summary: The seam between the factory and any external coding harness: one `run` returning plain data, and one `capabilities` probe that answers Supported, Unsupported or Unknown rather than assuming.

nodes.label: CommandRunner
nodes.subtitle: CommandSpec → CommandOutput
nodes.summary: The single way a harness reaches a process: a spec with program, args, workdir, a complete environment, stdin and a timeout, answered with an outcome and both streams.

nodes.label: RealCommandRunner
nodes.subtitle: child process + timeout
nodes.summary: Spawns the child with a cleared environment, drains both pipes on their own threads, feeds stdin, and kills the whole process tree at the deadline; a missing program is CouldNotRun.

nodes.label: Prompt & question contract
nodes.subtitle: build_prompt / question_line
nodes.summary: Builds the task prompt with the four rules appended, and reads a `QUESTION:` line from the last non-blank line of the final message — the only question signal the adapter has.

nodes.label: HarnessResult & Usage
nodes.subtitle: plain data for the journal
nodes.summary: The serializable result of a run: actor, session, final message, outcome, changed files, branch, head commit, summed token usage and cost; `blocked_event` turns an asked outcome into a journal payload.

nodes.label: FakeRunner / FakeHarness
nodes.subtitle: harness/fake.rs
nodes.summary: In-memory doubles that replay scripted answers and record every command and task, so a full run can be exercised without starting a process.

nodes.label: DshHarness
nodes.subtitle: impl Harness
nodes.summary: The concrete adapter: rejects an empty task or a dirty tree, snapshots head and branch, runs dsh, parses events, re-reads status and head, and refuses a run that moved the head.

nodes.label: Command builders
nodes.subtitle: build_command / git_*
nodes.summary: Pure functions that pin the dsh invocation (`--profile headless --json -`), the git status/head/branch probes, the probe commands, and the minimal git environment that keeps the API key out of git.

nodes.label: parse_events
nodes.subtitle: JSONL → Parsed
nodes.summary: Reduces the newline-delimited events to session id, final message, summed step usage and the first non-completed turn reason; a non-JSON line fails with its line number.

nodes.label: Capability probes
nodes.subtitle: version / help / dump-config
nodes.summary: Probes `--version` for presence and the pin, the headless help for `--json` and stdin, and the profile dump for the message-check plugin row, reporting Unknown when a probe cannot run.

nodes.label: dsh binary
nodes.subtitle: 0.2.0-rc.2
nodes.summary: The external coding harness the adapter drives; it prints newline-delimited JSON events and reports no model name and no cost.

nodes.label: git
nodes.subtitle: status / rev-parse
nodes.summary: Reads the working tree, the head commit and the branch; it is given only PATH, HOME and GIT_* so no credential reaches it.

nodes.label: harness_fake_run
nodes.subtitle: full run through the seam
nodes.summary: Drives a complete dsh run and a capability report through the fakes, asserting the exact commands that reach the runner and that the shared run helper names no harness.

nodes.label: harness_neutral
nodes.subtitle: no vendor, no harness name
nodes.summary: Scans the provider-neutral harness folder for agent names, container words and model-vendor words, and proves the scanner can fail on the adapter that does name a vendor.

nodes.label: Recorded dsh fixtures
nodes.subtitle: jsonl / help / dump
nodes.summary: Recorded runs — a created file, a question contract, prose questions, a missing credential — plus the version, help and profile-dump fixtures the parser and probes are tested against.

views.title: Harness seam and the dsh adapter
views.summary: The factory reaches an external coding harness only through the neutral `Harness` and `CommandRunner` traits; `DshHarness` is the first implementation, and the real runner is the only thing that spawns a process.

views.title: One dsh run, step by step
views.summary: What the adapter does around a single dsh invocation: guard the tree, snapshot head and branch, run, parse, re-read, and decide finished or asked.
